title: Spartan Protocol — Spot balanceOf() Based LP Withdrawal Calculation Vulnerability Analysis
root_cause: `removeLiquidity()` calculates withdrawal amounts using the current `balanceOf()` instead of synchronized reserve variables, making it manipulable via direct token donations
steps: Step 1: Flash loan 100,000 WBNB from PancakeSwap
Step 4: Direct transfer of WBNB to pool (no LP minted)
Step 6: Reverse swap SPARTA → WBNB + repay flash loan
